evidence.quoted_text:
require(payload["cli"]["rc"] not in (0, None),
            "interrupted recovery unexpectedly returned success")
evidence.reason: The current recover_kill_phase still only requires a nonzero exit status, not that the drain kill hook actually terminated the process with SIGKILL. A normal recover refusal can return nonzero while leaving the pending/drained record unchanged, so the subsequent checks can pass and falsely report an interrupted recovery. The intended kill-hook behavior is an exact SIGKILL status (-9), so this is an implementation error in the verification logic rather than a new product requirement.
